") center/cover
}
.hero h1,.hero h2{margin:0}
.hero p{margin:5px 0 0;opacity:.9}

.tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.tab{border:1px solid var(--line);background:white;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 13px;font-weight:850;color:#2c3851}
.tab.active{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.panel{display:none}.panel.active{display:block}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(22,42,87,.05)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:14px}
.col4{grid-column:span 4}.col5{grid-column:span 5}.col6{grid-column:span 6}.col7{grid-column:span 7}.col8{grid-column:span 8}.col12{grid-column:span 12}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:end;flex-wrap:wrap}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:145px}
.field label{font-size:12px;font-weight:850;color:#566174}
.field input,.field select{border:1px solid #ccd5e2;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;background:#fff;min-height:41px}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:850}
.btn.primary{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}.btn.lime{background:var(--lime);color:#11205b}.btn.soft{background:#edf1f7;color:#33405a}.btn.ok{background:#e4f7e8;color:#176a36}.btn.danger{background:#ffe6e6;color:#a01d1d}
.notice{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:11px;margin:10px 0;font-size:13px}
.notice.info{background:#eaf1ff;color:#174a9c}.notice.warn{background:#fff1db;color:#8d5c00}.notice.ok{background:#e7f6ea;color:#176b37}
.badge{display:inline-block;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.badge.free{background:#d9ecff;color:#14558c}
.badge.pending{background:#d9f0de;color:#246820}
.badge.confirmed{background:#bfe8c8;color:#185d2d}
.badge.fixed{background:#bfe8f7;color:#175b77}
.badge.professor{background:#f6a84b;color:#6a3900}
.small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}

/* PLAYER */
.player-filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.availability{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:11px}
.court-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:13px;background:#fff;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.court-thumb{width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:11px;object-fit:cover;flex:0 0 74px}
.court-info{flex:1;min-width:0}.court-info h3{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:16px}
.court-actions{margin-top:8px}
.time-section{margin-top:10px}
.time-section-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#42506a;margin-bottom:7px}
.time-slots{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.time-chip{
  border:1px solid #b8dba9;
  background:#e8f7df;
  color:#176329;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:7px 9px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:900;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.time-chip:hover{background:#a7d832;color:#071873;border-color:#a7d832}
.time-chip.forced-two-hours{
  background:#e8f7df;
  color:#176329;
  border-color:#b8dba9;
}
.time-chip.forced-two-hours:hover{
  background:#a7d832;
  color:#071873;
  border-color:#a7d832;
}
.busy-chip{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  border-radius:9px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;
  background:#e8edf5;color:#59657b;border:1px solid #dce3ed
}
.busy-chip.pending{background:#fff1d8;color:#8a5700;border-color:#f4d79e}
.no-slots{font-size:12px;color:#8b4650;background:#fff0f1;border-radius:9px;padding:8px}
.court-card{align-items:flex-start}
.court-info{min-width:0}
.empty{padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}

/* ADMIN */
.kpi{grid-column:span 3}.kpi strong{display:block;font-size:28px;color:var(--blue)}.kpi span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.schedule{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;min-width:1100px;width:100%}
.schedule th,.schedule td{border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center;padding:0}
.schedule th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:3;background:#102062;color:#fff;padding:8px;font-size:12px}
.schedule th:first-child{left:0;z-index:5}
.schedule td.time{position:sticky;left:0;z-index:2;background:#f7f9fc;padding:7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:850}
.slot{height:36px;min-width:112px;font-size:10px;padding:3px!important}
.slot.free{background:#fff}
.slot.eventual,.slot.confirmed{background:var(--eventual)}
.slot.pending{background:var(--pending)}
.slot.fixed{background:var(--fixed)}
.slot.professor{background:var(--professor)}
.slot.merged{
  vertical-align:middle;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.25;
  border-radius:0;
}
.slot.merged .turn-name{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  min-height:100%;
  padding:6px;
  text-align:center;
  word-break:break-word;
}
.slot.merged .turn-time{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.1;
  font-weight:950;
  color:#071873;
}
.slot.merged .turn-owner{
  display:block;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-weight:900;
}
.slot.merged .turn-status{
  display:block;
  margin-top:5px;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.2px;
}
.item-list{display:grid;gap:8px}
.item{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:11px;background:#fff;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.item .meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.reminder-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end}
.btn.sent{background:#dfe8f8;color:#274c8e}
.btn.attend-yes{background:#dff4e4;color:#176a36}
.btn.attend-no{background:#ffe5e5;color:#a01d1d}
.btn.attend-selected{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:1px}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.form-grid .full{grid-column:1/-1}

@media(max-width:850px){
  .col4,.col5,.col6,.col7,.col8,.col12{grid-column:1/-1}
  .kpi{grid-column:span 6}
  .login-title{font-size:42px}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  #loginScreen{padding:16px 12px 75px;align-items:flex-start;background-position:center}
  .login-wrap{padding-top:8px}
  .login-logo{width:128px;height:128px}
  .login-title{font-size:36px}
  .login-subtitle{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:4px}
  .login-card{padding:20px 16px;border-radius:22px}
  .input-shell{height:55px;border-radius:17px}
  .login-features{display:none}
  .brandline{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px}
  .admin-link{right:10px;bottom:10px;font-size:10px}
  .admin-modal{position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:56px;width:auto}
  main{padding:10px}
  .hero{min-height:105px}
  .kpi{grid-column:span 12}
  .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

/* SOLO ADMINISTRADOR > AGENDA: pendiente de confirmación */
#adminAgenda .schedule .slot.pending{
  background:#ffe39a !important;
}
#adminAgenda .schedule .slot.pending .badge.pending,
#adminAgenda .schedule .slot.pending .turn-status.badge.pending{
  background:#f5c542 !important;
  color:#5c4300 !important;
}


/* CABECERA FIJA DE CANCHAS EN ADMIN > AGENDA */
#stickyCourtHeader{
  position:fixed;
  z-index:45;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  top:68px;
  display:none;
  pointer-events:none;
}
#stickyCourtHeader .sticky-inner{
  overflow:hidden;
  margin:0 auto;
  background:#102062;
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(7,24,115,.16);
}
#stickyCourtHeader table{
  border-collapse:separate;
  border-spacing:0;
  table-layout:fixed;
  margin:0;
  color:#fff;
  background:#102062;
}
#stickyCourtHeader th{
  background:#102062;
  color:#fff;
  padding:8px;
  height:48px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:850;
  text-align:center;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.30);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  white-space:nowrap;
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  #stickyCourtHeader{top:68px}
}


/* RECAUDACIÓN */
.revenue-table{
  width:100%;
  border-collapse:collapse;
  min-width:520px;
}
.revenue-table th{
  background:#102062;
  color:#fff;
  padding:10px 8px;
  font-size:12px;
  text-align:left;
}
.revenue-table td{
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:10px 8px;
  font-size:13px;
}
.revenue-table td.num,
.revenue-table th.num{text-align:right}
.revenue-total-row td{
  font-weight:900;
  background:#f4f7fb;
}
.revenue-kind{
  display:inline-block;
  padding:3px 7px;
  border-radius:999px;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
}
.revenue-kind.fixed{background:#bfe8f7;color:#175b77}
.revenue-kind.professor{background:#f6a84b;color:#6a3900}
.revenue-kind.eventual{background:#bfe8c8;color:#185d2d}
.revenue-kind.pending{background:#ffe39a;color:#6d5200}


/* AJUSTE PANEL DERECHO > TURNOS FIJOS */
#adminFixed #fixedList .item{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,1fr) auto;
  align-items:center;
  gap:18px;
  min-height:112px;
  padding:16px 18px;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .item > div:first-child{
  min-width:0;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .item > div:first-child b{
  display:block;
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.2;
  margin-bottom:6px;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .item .meta{
  line-height:1.4;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .actions{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:nowrap;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:6px;
  min-width:max-content;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .btn,
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .badge{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  white-space:nowrap;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .btn{
  min-width:82px;
  padding:10px 14px;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.1;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .badge{
  min-width:70px;
  padding:8px 12px;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.1;
}

@media(max-width:1050px){
  #adminFixed #fixedList .item{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions{
    justify-content:flex-start;
    overflow-x:auto;
    padding-bottom:2px;
  }
}


.date-hint{
  margin-top:8px;
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1.2;
  color:#2f456a;
}


/* V28 — AJUSTE DE LAYOUT EN ADMIN > TURNOS FIJOS */
#adminFixed > .grid{
  grid-template-columns: 0.82fr 1.18fr !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
  align-items:start;
}

/* Tarjetas izquierda y derecha */
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child{
  min-width:0;
}
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:last-child{
  min-width:0;
}

/* Panel izquierdo un poco más compacto */
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child h3,
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child h2{
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child .notice{
  padding:14px 16px;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.35;
}
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child .field label{
  font-size:12px;
}
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child input,
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child select{
  padding:10px 12px;
  min-height:42px;
}
#adminFixed > .grid > .card:first-child .btn{
  padding:11px 16px;
  font-size:13px;
}

/* Tarjetas del panel derecho */
#adminFixed #fixedList .item{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(230px,1fr) auto;
  align-items:center;
  gap:14px;
  min-height:106px;
  padding:14px 16px;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .item > div:first-child{
  min-width:0;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .item > div:first-child b{
  display:block;
  font-size:17px;
  line-height:1.18;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .item .meta{
  line-height:1.35;
  font-size:13px;
}

/* Acciones: PROFESOR arriba, ACTIVO abajo, y 3 botones al lado */
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:auto auto auto auto;
  grid-template-rows:auto auto;
  column-gap:6px;
  row-gap:6px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:end;
  min-width:max-content;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions > *{
  white-space:nowrap;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions > :nth-child(1){
  grid-column:1;
  grid-row:1;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions > :nth-child(2){
  grid-column:1;
  grid-row:2;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions > :nth-child(3){
  grid-column:2;
  grid-row:1 / span 2;
  align-self:center;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions > :nth-child(4){
  grid-column:3;
  grid-row:1 / span 2;
  align-self:center;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions > :nth-child(5){
  grid-column:4;
  grid-row:1 / span 2;
  align-self:center;
}

/* Botones y badges más compactos para que entren dentro del margen */
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .btn{
  min-width:78px !important;
  padding:9px 12px !important;
  font-size:12px !important;
  line-height:1.08 !important;
  text-align:center;
}
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .badge{
  min-width:68px !important;
  padding:7px 10px !important;
  font-size:11px !important;
  line-height:1.08 !important;
  text-align:center;
}

/* En pantallas medianas, mantiene claridad y evita desbordes */
@media(max-width:1280px){
  #adminFixed > .grid{
    grid-template-columns: 0.78fr 1.22fr !important;
  }
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions .btn{
    min-width:72px !important;
    padding:8px 10px !important;
    font-size:11px !important;
  }
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions .badge{
    min-width:62px !important;
    padding:6px 8px !important;
    font-size:10px !important;
  }
}

/* En pantallas más chicas, vuelve a una sola columna */
@media(max-width:1050px){
  #adminFixed > .grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr !important;
  }
  #adminFixed #fixedList .item{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions{
    justify-content:start;
    overflow-x:auto;
    padding-bottom:2px;
  }
}


/* V29 — MISMO ANCHO, TEXTO Y BOTONES MÁS GRANDES EN TURNOS FIJOS */
#adminFixed #fixedList .item{
  min-height:122px;
  padding:18px 22px;
  gap:20px;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .item > div:first-child b{
  font-size:21px !important;
  line-height:1.2;
  margin-bottom:7px;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .item .meta{
  font-size:15px !important;
  line-height:1.4;
}

#adminFixed #fixedList .actions{
  column-gap:10px !important;
  row-gap:8px !important;
}

/* PROFESOR / FIJO y ACTIVO / PAUSADO más grandes */
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .badge{
  min-width:86px !important;
  padding:9px 13px !important;
  font-size:13px !important;
  line-height:1.1 !important;
  font-weight:900 !important;
}

/* Editar / Pausar / Borrar más grandes */
#adminFixed #fixedList .actions .btn{
  min-width:104px !important;
  padding:12px 17px !important;
  font-size:14px !important;
  line-height:1.1 !important;
  font-weight:900 !important;
}

/* Aprovechar el espacio sin cambiar el ancho general de los paneles */
@media(min-width:1281px){
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions .btn{
    min-width:110px !important;
    padding:13px 19px !important;
    font-size:15px !important;
  }
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions .badge{
    min-width:92px !important;
    padding:10px 15px !important;
    font-size:14px !important;
  }
}

@media(max-width:1280px){
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions .btn{
    min-width:92px !important;
    padding:10px 14px !important;
    font-size:13px !important;
  }
  #adminFixed #fixedList .actions .badge{
    min-width:80px !important;
    padding:8px 11px !important;
    font-size:12px !important;
  }
}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<section id="loginScreen">
  <div class="login-wrap">
    <img class="login-logo" src="data:image/png;base64,
